channel.title: My Fairy Troublemaker
channel.desc: Violetta, a mischievous tooth fairy who fails her exam, becomes stranded in the human world. There she befriends Maxie?a girl adjusting to a new family?and together they embark on a quest to help Violetta return. In the process, Violetta discovers her powers and true identity as a flower fairy.
